food_price.title: FAO Food Price Index October 2026
food_price.facts: FFPI 133.9, -1.2% m/m, +5.9% y/y; cereals -4.5% m/m; sugar +6.6% m/m/+28.8% y/y; 41 countries/territories require external food assistance (31 Africa). Included in MT-GM-2026-11-26 revision 2.

who_bundibugyo.title: WHO Bundibugyo disease outbreak update
who_bundibugyo.facts: As of 17 Nov: 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths across 68 health zones in 8 DRC provinces; PHEIC continued 18 Nov. Existing 21 Nov report already covers this update; no newer WHO update found in this screen.

fao_mongolia.title: FAO-WOAH SAT1 field assessment in Mongolia

epa_permit.title: EPA 2026 Pesticide General Permit
epa_permit.facts: Permit effective 31 Oct 2026 through 30 Oct 2031; no new exposure/outcome dataset identified in this screen.

opcw_biotoxin.title: OPCW decision on biotoxin-analysis laboratory designation
opcw_biotoxin.facts: CSP-31 adopted a decision on designation of laboratories capable of analysing authentic samples for biotoxins and guidelines for official proficiency tests; institutional capacity step, not an allegation of biotoxin use.

unhcr_displacement.title: UNHCR Mid-Year Trends 2026
unhcr_displacement.facts: At end June 2026, 41.7m refugees and 69.4m internally displaced people due to conflict or violence; aggregate mid-year data, not a forecast of imminent war.

mdic_decarb.title: MDIC/Embrapii/GIZ-IKI call for steel and cement decarbonization projects
mdic_decarb.facts: Up to R$81m non-repayable resources; 15 proposed innovation projects; applications through Embrapii coordinating unit due 29 Jan 2027; results 12 Apr 2027; projects up to 30 months.

aneel_transmission.title: ANEEL Transmission Auction 4/2026 result
aneel_transmission.facts: 8 lots awarded; approx. R$8.8bn investment; 1,866 km new lines; 12,694 MVA transformation; 50.10% discount; operation deadlines 42–60 months.

aneel_2027.title: ANEEL 1/2027 transmission auction pipeline
aneel_2027.facts: Planned 30 Apr 2027 auction: 12 lots, 3,245 km new lines, 1,386 MVA, 13 states; TCU submission expected Dec 2026.

ustr.title: USTR Section 301 determinations and proposed actions
ustr.facts: Formal determinations and proposed actions for 14 economies; public comments due 5 Jan 2027 and hearings from 25 Jan; tariffs are proposed, not effective.
